name: helgatheviking/glotpress-whitelabel
description: White-labels GlotPress to match your brand identity.

prefix-namespaces: sh -c 'test -f bin/strauss.phar || { mkdir -p bin && curl -fL -o bin/strauss.phar https://github.com/BrianHenryIE/strauss/releases/latest/download/strauss.phar; }'

scripts-descriptions.i18n: Generate translation files (POT and JSON) for internationalization
scripts-descriptions.make-pot: Generate a POT file for translations
scripts-descriptions.make-json: Generate JSON translation files from POT files for JavaScript internationalization
scripts-descriptions.prefix-namespaces: Use Strauss to prefix namespaces of composer packages
